'''2009 Dantooine Regionals Stephen Coovert LS Careful Planning''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Stephen Coovert]] at [[2009 Dantooine Regionals]].

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Careful Planning|Endor-L-carefulplanning.gif}}
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Original VS17]]
